title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 10 in E minor

character.text: Strict two-part fugue in double counterpoint throughout, in mirrored halves

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Upper: a figure from countersubject 1 (6 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times). Lower: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 24–29).

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in G major (Upper); Subject in D major (Lower)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Upper: a figure from countersubject 1 (5 times). Lower: a figure from countersubject 1 (6 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar.

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in A minor (Lower); Subject in E minor (Upper)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 5–10) in part, with upper and lower exchanged, transposed. Upper: a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Lower: a figure from countersubject 1 (5 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times).

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor (Lower); Subject in A minor (Upper)
